Messages.Author: M_Burton
Messages.Body:
Not having an Information Highway myself, I was very happy when I
succesfully voted Diputed Territory and snagged my prey's. Then, I put
my prey out of business (and the game) and lost it when he left. That's
right, isn't it? When someone leaves the game, all their cards go with
them, right?

In another game, someone stole my Hellhound from me, and then they got
ousted. I argued that my Hellhound, now free of it's mind daze, should
be able to search the city and find me, returning to my control. My
friends wouldn't go along with my logic, though.

--Mark

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <mburtonD...@netcom.com>, M_Burton <mbu...@netcom.com> wrote:
>Not having an Information Highway myself, I was very happy when I
>succesfully voted Diputed Territory and snagged my prey's. Then, I put
>my prey out of business (and the game) and lost it when he left. That's
>right, isn't it? When someone leaves the game, all their cards go with
>them, right?

Correct. Section 9 of the rulebook.

>
>In another game, someone stole my Hellhound from me, and then they got
>ousted. I argued that my Hellhound, now free of it's mind daze, should
>be able to search the city and find me, returning to my control. My
>friends wouldn't go along with my logic, though.

Any opponents cards a Methuselah ahs when she is ousted are
returned to their owners' ash heaps. Again from Section 9.

The Design Team thinks that Malkavian Dementia generates an exception
to this rule, but not Far Mastery or what have you.

('Course we don't all agree with the Design Team when they generate
hodge-podge rulings) :-).

--

>

Well, in response to the first question :

The info highway will be returned to its owner at the end of the game,
and not necesserily when that player leaves play.

And to the second :

Having an ally stolen is a permanent condition - it will not return.
Think of it this way. In the game, all allies, vampires, and other
minions believe they are working to their own ends, and that the meth.
simply exerts influance without their knowledge. Well, when the meth is
ousted, and can no longer exert influance, the vampires will still keep
working towards their own ends(which, in fact, they really are now, with
that meth. not controlling them) It is unlikely that they would give up
control of the hell hound which they stole.

- tony, Prince of Iowa City
